ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle, so I have little use for another streaming stick right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage fits my interests, but I would skip this capacity without a specific device needing it.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Echo Dot, so this older model adds little for me.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K Max makes this older streaming device redundant.
ItemID: 5; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my home electronics and computers right now than wired earbuds.
ItemID: 6; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This older tablet with limited storage does not address an evident need in my current setup.
ItemID: 7; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a useful spare for my TV and Blu-ray equipment; the longer cable gives me placement flexibility.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a stand for my second-generation Echo Show 5, so an older replacement is unappealing.
ItemID: 9; Title: SanDisk Ultra 64GB MicroSDXC Class 10 UHS Memory Card Speed Up To 30MB/s With Adapter - SDSDQUA-064G-U46A [Old Version]; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Extra storage interests me, but I would check device compatibility and newer options before choosing this old version.
ItemID: 10; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An HD streaming stick offers little benefit alongside my existing 4K Max.
